title: Tip about a Russian intelligence officer hiding as a monk on Mount Athos

tellings.quote: Which was I'd been given a tip by a Greek very close to the president prime minister of Greece uh about a monk at Mount Athos who was actually a Russian intelligence officer who was big getting cover and changing his identity to go on a mission to the US on behalf of Russian intelligence

plain: A man called Ralph, described as a former chief at the CIA, the US spy agency, says that in 1991 a Greek man very close to Greece's prime minister gave him a tip. The tip was that a monk at Mount Athos, a Greek mountain full of monasteries, was really a Russian intelligence officer taking on a new identity to go on a spy mission to the United States. Ralph says a file was kept on the monk.
